ACT OF CASH SALE

STATE OF LOUISIANA
PARISH OF ORLEANS

BE IT KNOWN, that on this 14th day of April, 2026, before me, the undersigned Notary Public, duly commissioned and qualified in and for the Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana, and in the presence of the two competent witnesses whose names are signed below, personally came and appeared:

THOMAS AURELIO HARPER, a person of the full age of majority, domiciled in the Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana, whose mailing address is 412 Sycamore Lane, New Orleans, Louisiana 70118 (the "Vendor"),

who declared that, for the price and on the terms stated below, he does by these presents grant, bargain, sell, convey, transfer, assign, set over, abandon, and deliver, with full warranty of title and with subrogation to all rights and actions of warranty against all preceding owners and vendors, unto:

NADIA HARPER OKONKWO, a person of the full age of majority, domiciled in the Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana, whose mailing address is 88 Beech Row, New Orleans, Louisiana 70119 (the "Purchaser"),

here present, accepting and purchasing for herself, her heirs and assigns, and acknowledging delivery and possession of, the following described immovable property, to wit:

DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY

A certain lot of ground, together with all the buildings and improvements thereon, and all the rights, ways, privileges, servitudes, appurtenances, and advantages thereunto belonging or in anywise appertaining, situated in the Third District of the City of New Orleans, Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana, in Square No. 412 bounded by Sycamore Lane, Beech Row, Larkspur Street, and Foundry Road, designated as Lot 14 on a survey by Ellery Doyle, Civil Engineer, dated March 3, 2019, a copy of which is annexed to an act registered in COB 2019, folio 1148, of the records of the Parish of Orleans.

Being the same property acquired by the Vendor by act of sale before Rosalind Achebe Kwan, Notary Public, dated June 3, 2019, registered in COB 2019, folio 0882.

TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the described property unto the Purchaser, her heirs and assigns forever.

PRICE

This sale is made and accepted for the price and sum of NINE HUNDRED THOUSAND AND NO/100 ($900,000.00) DOLLARS cash, which the Purchaser has well and truly paid, in ready current money, to the Vendor, who hereby acknowledges receipt thereof and grants full acquittance and discharge therefor.

TAXES AND ASSESSMENTS

All State, Parish, and City taxes assessed against the property up to and including the year 2025 have been paid, as shown by the tax research certificate annexed hereto. Taxes for the year 2026 have been prorated as of the date of this act.

CERTIFICATES

The production of mortgage, conveyance, and tax research certificates is waived by the parties, who release and relieve me, Notary, of all responsibility and liability in connection therewith.

WAIVER OF WARRANTY AGAINST REDHIBITORY DEFECTS

The Purchaser expressly waives the warranty against redhibitory defects and vices provided by Louisiana Civil Code articles 2520 through 2548, including the warranty of fitness for the Purchaser's intended use, and accepts the property "AS IS, WHERE IS," without any warranty whatever as to its condition, even for a defect that is not apparent. The Purchaser acknowledges that this waiver has been read, explained, and is expressly accepted, and that the price reflects it. The Purchaser further waives any right to rescind this sale or to reduce the price for any vice or defect in the property.

THUS DONE AND PASSED in my office at New Orleans, Louisiana, on the day and date first above written, in the presence of the undersigned competent witnesses, who have signed with the parties and me, Notary, after due reading of the whole.

WITNESSES:                                PARTIES:

/s/ Marcus Ellery Doyle                   /s/ Thomas Aurelio Harper
Marcus Ellery Doyle                       THOMAS AURELIO HARPER, Vendor

/s/ Devon Achebe                          /s/ Nadia Harper Okonkwo
Devon Achebe                              NADIA HARPER OKONKWO, Purchaser

/s/ Rosalind Achebe Kwan
ROSALIND ACHEBE KWAN, NOTARY PUBLIC
Louisiana Bar Roll No. 24118
My commission is issued for life.
